title: Trailer provenance anchors
style: Cinematic, desaturated teal-and-amber grade, warm low sun against cool stone shadow, crushed blacks, filmic highlight rolloff, fine grain, shallow depth of field, dust in the light. Ancient Olympia. Photographic realism, natural skin texture, no stylisation, no modern detail, no text.

shots.title: B1 kotinos
shots.framing: artefact hero, already verified — do not restage
shots.motion: Very slow push in on the artefact. Movement: the camera advances a few centimetres over the whole clip. Speed: almost imperceptible. Framing: the object stays centred and every inscription stays exactly as rendered. End: fractionally closer, identical composition. The artefact itself does not move, rotate or change.
